## Checklist

- [ ] Exercise changes are authored on **`solutions`**, not on `main`.
      (`main` is regenerated by `tools/Make-StudentVersion.ps1`; edits made there are overwritten.)
- [ ] `dotnet test` passes on `solutions` (all exercises green).
- [ ] Every new `[Fact]` has a `// Task:` comment and an explicit result type on the `TODO` slot.
- [ ] Ran `powershell -File tools/Update-ReadmeTables.ps1` if exercises were added, removed or renamed.
- [ ] If the method README's exercise count or difficulty split changed, its header table was updated.
- [ ] `LinqGym/Data/SchoolData.cs` is unchanged, or `docs/DATASET.md` was updated to match and the full
      suite still passes. (Hundreds of expected values depend on this data.)

## Docs only / typo fix

Tick this and ignore the rest if the change touches no `*Exercises.cs` file:

- [ ] Documentation or tooling only.
